name: Toe
overview: The Scriptures highlight the toe, particularly the great toe of the right foot, as a significant point of consecration and purification in the Old Testament sacrificial system. In passages such as Exodus 29:20 and Leviticus 8:23-24, the anointing of the great toe with blood symbolizes dedication to God during the ordination of priests. Similarly, Leviticus 14 details the application of blood and oil on the great toe as part of the cleansing ritual for those being purified. These practices underscore the comprehensive nature of consecration and purification, extending even to the extremities, signifying total commitment to the Lord.
